Overleaf projesi (.zip) ya da .tex dosya: Overleaf project (.zip) or .tex file; compiled on your computer without Overleaf's time limit
MiKTeX (ücretsiz LaTeX dağıtımı, temel k: MiKTeX (a free LaTeX distribution, basic install about 1 GB) will be downloaded from the internet and installed. Packages your documents need are downloaded on the first compile. Windows may ask for permission to install, and the process can take a few minutes.
LaTeX (MiKTeX ya da TeX Live) bulunamadı: LaTeX (MiKTeX or TeX Live) was not found; .tex files can't be compiled.
Derlenecek bir .tex dosyası ya da proje: Add a .tex file or a project .zip to compile.
Overleaf'ten indirdiğin proje .zip'ini y: Drop the project .zip you downloaded from Overleaf, or a .tex file (with its images and .bib files)
Otomatik: belgedeki % !TEX program satır: Automatic: uses the document's % !TEX program line, otherwise looks at the packages (fontspec → XeLaTeX). You can pick whatever is set under Menu → Compiler in Overleaf.
Boş bırakılırsa \\documentclass içeren d: If left empty, the file with \documentclass is used (main.tex first).
Birden çok .tex var; boş bırakılırsa \\d: There are several .tex files; if left empty, the one with \documentclass is used.
Hata olsa da PDF üretilebiliyorsa üretil: If a PDF can be produced despite errors, it is, and the errors are shown as warnings. The first compile can take a while because missing packages are downloaded.
LaTeX derlemesi yalnızca bu bilgisayarda: LaTeX compiling is only available on the computer itself; it is turned off in phone mode.
